messages:
Maya Patel: FYI HelixCare procurement just dropped a vendor questionnaire mixing DPA + PCI items. They want encryption-at-rest details, CMK options, audit-log retention and SOC2 scope. Deadline: Fri EOD or PO delayed.

Jordan Kim: Thanks 609. Who's replying? Standard DPA bundle + PCI blurb ok?

Liam O'Neil: I can own the reply. Need security-approved wording for KMS and audit exports. Also confirm EU residency line.

Devon Chen: Ill write safe responses. Paste below can be reused.

Devon Chen: ```Q: Is data encrypted at rest?
A: Yes. Customer data in Redwood-hosted storage is encrypted with AES-256. Hosted uses provider-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private can integrate customer-managed KMS or HSM.```

Devon Chen: ```Q: Encryption in transit?
A: TLS 1.3 enforced for all connections. Mutual TLS supported for Private deployments.```

Devon Chen: ```Q: Audit logs and retention?
A: Audit logs (access events, admin actions, key rotations) retained 90 days by default in Hosted; configurable up to 12 months for Dedicated/Private with enterprise add-on. Redacted sample events available under NDA.```

Devon Chen: ```Q: SOC2 scope?
A: Redwood maintains SOC2 Type II for our platform services. For Private/on-prem customers, Redwood provides documentation and evidence to support customer audits.```

Maya Patel: Perfect. Liam please paste and add a one-line note about on-prem/air-gapped support.

Liam O'Neil: Will do. Quick check: safe to offer sample logs under NDA?

Devon Chen: Yes. We redact tokens and PII. Provide schema + examples.

OnboardBot: Task created: "Send compliance answers to HelixCare" assigned to Liam O'Neil, due 2025-11-07.

Liam O'Neil: Drafted & sent at 1768007801. Included Devon wording + sentence: "Hosted customers may request CMK support under enterprise contract; Private deployments support customer HSM." Flagging renewal risk: if PO delayed >2 weeks escalate to AE.

Maya Patel: Thanks all 44d. Paste HelixCare reply here once they respond.

Liam O'Neil: HelixCare acked at 1768007899. One follow-up: do we offer field-level tokenization for PII? Asked them for specifics and looping in Devon.

Devon Chen: We offer application-level tokenization patterns today; for strict PCI field-level tokenization recommend Private deployment with customer HSM. Ill draft a short note to paste.

Maya Patel: Great. Low-friction replies keep procurement moving and reduce renewal risk.
